newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 2.345 billion yuan from 3.412 billion yuan last Friday with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was less active mainly due to a lack of new issues on the domestic A share market which pushed down short-term fund demand, traders said.
The recent downward trend of the domestic A share markets was another factor preventing non-banking financial institutions including securities brokerages from trading actively, they said.

Despite today's fall, trading has become more active in the past few weeks partly due to continued new issues of state debt, traders said. They said they believed the interbank rates would move in a narrow range in active trading in the short term.
